reason: A Notion integration plugin that provides agent tools and a web settings page for searching, reading, creating, updating, and appending content in authorized Notion pages and databases.

summaries.zh: 连接 Notion 工作区，为智能体提供搜索、读取、创建、更新页面及追加内容的工具，并提供令牌配置页面。
summaries.en: Connects to a Notion workspace, providing agent tools to search, read, create, update, and append content, along with a token configuration page.

capabilities: Connects to the Notion API using an integration token
Searches and reads Notion pages and databases
Creates and modifies Notion pages and appends content blocks
Stores the integration token in a local configuration file
